name: Bolvinnus

attributes.attribute: a god from the province of Gaul
equated by the Romans with Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bolvinnus is a Continental Celtic god. He came from the land of Gaul. Little is known about him. The Romans saw him as the same god as their own warrior god Mars. The sources say no more about Bolvinnus.

okr.objective: Describe Bolvinnus, the little-known Gallic god equated with Mars.
key_results: Bolvinnus was a Continental Celtic god.
The Romans identified him with Mars.
